evals.prompt: Bootstrap me on this before the refactor: gather the relevant context for the payments module, I know nothing about it.
evals.expected_output: Builds a compact task-scoped bundle in priority order (repo state, handoff, plan, memory, standards, RAG hits), stopping when the next read would not change the action.
assertions: Follows context load order: repo state, handoff, plan, memory, standards
Pulls only task-relevant files, docs and notes rather than reading broadly
Stops accumulating once the next read would not change the action
Checks the External HD mount guard and falls back to grep if RAG is unreachable

evals.prompt: Load context for the retry-queue bug. RAG returned nothing and there are no plans or handoffs for it.
evals.expected_output: Falls back to reading the 2 or 3 most relevant files directly without speculative expansion.
assertions: Reads only the 2-3 most relevant files directly
Does not expand the read set speculatively

evals.prompt: Change the timeout constant in the config module from 30 to 60.
evals.expected_output: Single known file: direct read, no context pack.
assertions: Does not run a multi-source context bundle
